source.source: HYG v4.4 (Hipparcos-Yale-Gliese Database, D. Nash / astronexus)
source.epoch: ICRS/J2000 equinox; source astrometry primarily Hipparcos-2007 reduction, epoch J1991.25
source.sentinelDistDoc: dist == 100000.0 marks an unmeasurable/negative Hipparcos parallax; rows with it are dropped, not shipped.
source.hipSentinelDoc: hip == 0 means the row has no Hipparcos catalogue number.

galacticFrame.source: Hipparcos Catalogue vol. 1 §1.5.3 (ESA SP-1200, 1997); J2000 galactic frame constants shared by astropy and SOFA

panorama.title: The Milky Way panorama
panorama.longitudeConvention: l = 0 at the column centre, increasing leftward (sky seen from inside)
panorama.latitudeConvention: b = +90 at row 0, -90 at the last row

catalogRegistration.role: retained source record only; the photograph is registered astrometrically and owns visible stars

pointSourcePresentation.positionSource: licensed ESO photographic local maxima; no Google catalogue bytes
pointSourcePresentation.qualification: native fixed-size catalogue behavior collapsed into the prepared cubemap; point positions and colors remain ESO-derived

sky.qualification: source-photographed full sky sampled in ICRF through the J2000 galactic frame and the anchor-registered panorama; the scene registration carries the Mars pole and epoch; Solar System objects in the mosaic are capture artefacts; no Sun is baked into the cubemap
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

analyticRadialFit.qualification: Least-squares fit to annular red-channel means from the bound native 128 by 128 Sun texture; fitted values only, no source pixels.

distanceScaling.qualification: The opaque photospheric core is projected from the IAU nominal solar radius and the object catalog's mean heliocentric distance. The retained glow profile remains a visual presentation; the distance is not epoch-specific.

provenance.source: VSOP87A heliocentric positions with IAU/WGCCRE rotation elements
provenance.qualification: Observed Mars Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.

controls.label: Visible color
controls.description: USGS Viking MDIM 2.1 global mosaic, colorized with NASA Ames processing. Source sampling is about 1 km; resolution and photographed lighting vary. This assembled historical map does not depict the scene date.
controls.summary: Surface detail comes from Viking images with NASA Ames color. Lighting and resolution vary; these are archival observations.
controls.title: MDIM 2.1 colorized global mosaic

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Mars Global Surveyor MOLA topography shown with the source pseudo-color shaded-relief palette. Colors indicate relative elevation, with cartographic shading; this is a prepared global display mosaic, not a current photograph or numeric height readout.
controls.summary: Colors describe terrain height and shading reveals slopes. This published relief image does not provide a numeric readout.
controls.title: MOLA global color shaded relief

controls.label: Thermal infrared
controls.description: USGS/ASU THEMIS daytime infrared brightness mosaic from Mars Odyssey. Black areas at the north and south map edges are exact-zero source fill without observations; dark interior samples are real. No Viking imagery fills thermal gaps. Multiple observations are combined; this is not a temperature map or the scene date.
controls.summary: Brightness records daytime infrared intensity from combined observations. Black bands at the map edges are missing source coverage, not measurements.
controls.title: THEMIS daytime infrared mosaic
